---
title: Table
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Universal table renderer preserving exact CSV strings with true numerical sorting
function renderSmartTable(fileAttachment, options = {}) {
  // Read CSV as raw strings to preserve exact formatting (4.34e10, 1311435, etc.)
  return fileAttachment.csv().then(rawRows => {
    if (!rawRows.length) return Inputs.table(rawRows);
    
    const columns = rawRows.columns || Object.keys(rawRows[0]);
    
    // Wrap cell values so Inputs.table sorts numerically but renders raw strings
    const smartRows = rawRows.map(row => {
      const newRow = {};
      for (const col of columns) {
        const raw = row[col] != null ? String(row[col]).trim() : "";
        if (raw === "") {
          newRow[col] = "";
          continue;
        }
        
        const num = Number(raw);
        if (!isNaN(num)) {
          // Numeric cell: valueOf() returns number for sorting, toString() returns raw string
          newRow[col] = {
            valueOf: () => num,
            toString: () => raw
          };
        } else {
          // Text cell
          newRow[col] = raw;
        }
      }
      return newRow;
    });

    return Inputs.table(smartRows, {
      search: true,
      sort: true,
      rows: 15,
      ...options
    });
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
renderSmartTable(FileAttachment("../data/bounds.csv"))
```
